sourceIntro: Bring a video, choose your subject, and turn visible expression into a finished story.
dropHint: MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM · 2 GB default limit
fullDefault: The full video is selected by default. Adjust the sliders to choose a section.
personIntro: Detect the people, then click a numbered box. Seek after a cut to add another anchor.
speaker: Subject name
anchorsHint: Times are relative to the clip; auto-start mode uses source time.
descriptionHint: A description replaces numbered selection and makes a small API request.
selectPerson: Click a person in the frame
lookIntro: Drag over a watermark to blur it. Coordinates are converted to source pixels automatically.
title: Video title
burnedHint: Keep the original subtitles without drawing another layer. Confirm the detected region.
subtitleNone: No subtitle region detected. You can enable this manually.
talkIntro: Prepare the timeline, then click a subtitle to change speakers. Drag on the timeline to mark someone else speaking.
prepareHint: Prepare, detect, track, transcribe and segment with local models. Experimental description selection uses the API.
timelineHint: Click a subtitle to toggle speakers. Drag outside subtitle blocks to mark another speaker. Click thumbnails to seek.
prepareFirst: Run preparation to load real subtitles and shot boundaries.
generateIntro: Review your settings and create landscape and portrait videos. Follow every stage as it runs.
cacheHint: Changing only title, blur or subtitle display will re-render using the cached analysis.
costHint: Costs come from run records · Cached results make no new API calls
settingsIntro: Check your environment and configure this local workspace.
keyHint: Only the status is shown. A new key is written to the local .env file and never echoed.
historyIntro: Continue a previous production or watch your finished videos.
emptyHistory: No finished videos yet. Start with a source clip.
footerHint: Your source files and videos stay on this computer
disclaimer: Uncalibrated · For demonstration only · Not a psychological assessment
failed: Task failed. Open the log for details.
invalid_request: Invalid input. Check the source, subject and range.
busy: A task is already running. Wait or cancel it first.
http_413: The video exceeds the upload size limit.
http_403: Request rejected. Refresh the local page.
select_target: Choose a subject or enter an experimental description.
range_error: The end must be later than the start.
blockers: Some environment checks need attention. Open Settings for repair instructions.
repairModel: Run jevtells download to get models and fonts.
repairKey: Enter your OpenRouter key on the right and save.
repairFfmpeg: Install ffmpeg with libx264 (macOS: brew install ffmpeg).
